es_potter.text: Parian china. It's fired thin, so you can see the light through the cup. If you drop it, you'll hear the whole parish sigh.
The basket-weave's the thing. Every piece is rolled by hand, from strips of clay. It's slow, but it's Belleek.

es_hydro_man.text: The falls at Assaroe were a sight. When they built the station, a lot of that was gone. Everyone has views on it. I just keep the turbines turning.
Seventy years of electricity from the Erne. A lough that makes your tea. That's a good trade.

es_walker.text: Miles of boardwalk, and not one inch of bog harmed. They've done it right. Well. They've done it as right as a boardwalk can be.
The summit's a plateau, and the wind up there has a plan. I recommend a good hat.

gate_erne_shore.text: Road's closed. Works on the Erne. Very serious works. We've a cone.
The Keeper at the shipyard in Belfast has the say on this road, and he hasn't said it yet. Ask Ruairí. Past the cranes, the big shed.
